description: The source describes a PV network with two medium-voltage feeders, each with three inverters, plus model parameters, measurements and results for simple and sophisticated false-data scenarios. File descriptors name a network JSON, a measurement archive, scenario-result archives and a network diagram. Only descriptive metadata was inspected; no archive content or independent measurement count is asserted. This specific six-inverter test resource is distinct from the 180-bus distribution-grid and energy-community packages. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
